summary: Pass all battles (#628): a passAllBattles command/button for either player in battles. The engine passes for a flagged player and, as Attacker, selects the lowest remaining battlefield; an opposing action ends it; both players taking it resolves all remaining battles and ends the Attack Phase. Client footer button added.
